doc.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Siblings who all played music and became educators
summary: He names his brother and two sisters, all of whom played music and went into education.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You had two siblings, I think?
Yes. Did you have brothers and sisters?
Yes, I have two sisters and one brother.
Would you mind stating their names?
Yes. My brother’s named William—William Donaldson. My older sister is Elouise Donaldson. My younger sister was Pauline.
Yup. All played music. All went into education. All are now retired and rich.
Was your mother the main teacher?
Not really. I mean, she started them out, but they originally went to college...all of them went to college.
